item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 12/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier with temperatures falling slightly over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of the band of clouds associated with the broad area of low pressure over the southern part of the South China Sea, there will be a few rain patches over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coastal areas in the next couple of days. With the band of clouds thinning out gradually during the weekend, daytime temperatures will rise slightly over the coast of Guangdong. A relatively dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China early next week. It will be mainly fine and windier over the region.
